Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

You emphasise both partnership and reliability; it sounds like you want a lasting relationship, not simply another order. We value that relationship and want sustained defect reduction without punitive financial pressure. How would you underpin a binding quality commitment with a root-cause and corrective-action report that shows how recurrence will be prevented?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Your quality over the last 12 months was 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3). We understand cash flow matters to you: we will pay every invoice reliably on the agreed day. Please send us your 8D report and a binding ppm commitment.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (800 ppm, EUR 150 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit; 300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

How can the verified decline in electricity producer prices support a lower unit price alongside a binding quality commitment?
